model.title: To make technical amendments to update statutory references to provisions reclassified to title 34, United States Code, and to correct related technical errors.

summary.text: The bill would make technical corrections to federal law to update outdated references to crime control and law enforcement provisions that were reclassified within the U.S. Code.
